title: Storage Bundle Discount Credit on a Parking License Monthly Fee Line
content:
Parking receivable accounting standard: the amount of the storage bundle discount credit on a Parking License monthly fee line.

## Clause

The fee line credited is the most recent monthly fee line of the license; it earns the credit only when the storage rental is active and its start date falls on or before the fee line's posting date, and a fee line posted before the storage rental started earns none. The bundle rate is the product's storage bundle rate. The storage bundle discount credit is the bundle rate times the posted amount of the fee line, rounded half up to the cent.

The storage rental is the lease's Storage Rental in active status; its start date is compared with the posting date of the Parking License fee line.

## Whether the fee line earns a credit

| Storage Rental on the lease | Its start date against the fee line's posting date | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| active | before the posting date | earned |
| active | on the posting date itself | earned ("on or before") |
| active | after the posting date | none |
| none active | — | none |

## Worked examples (hypothetical products and fee lines)

| Posted amount of the most recent monthly fee line | Bundle rate | Calculation in words | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| $65.00 | 10% | 0.10 multiplied by $65.00 | $6.50 |
| $125.00 | 10% | 0.10 multiplied by $125.00 | $12.50 |
| $235.00 | 15% | 0.15 multiplied by $235.00 | $35.25 |
| $30.65 (a prorated line) | 10% | 0.10 multiplied by $30.65, which is $3.065, rounded half up | $3.07 |

The credit is measured on the amount actually posted on the fee line, so a prorated line yields a proportionally smaller credit.
